title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Agentic AI
description:

Big opportunities. Real impact. Amazing people. That's the Cyara experience.

Background implementing or administering enterprise planning and/or modeling technology OR Prior pre-sales experience in Enterprise Planning Management/Business Process Management

title: Tempus+ Medical Director
description:
Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?
Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. Tempus ' proprietary platform connects an entire ecosystem of real-world evidence to deliver real-time, actionable insights to physicians, providing critical information about the right treatments for the right patients, at the right time.
We are seeking a Medical Director to join our Medical team leading the Tempus + program.
Tempus + is our collaborative external research network that connects academic institutions and health systems to accelerate data-driven research in oncology. Participants gain unparalleled access to Lens, our cutting-edge, AI-empowered analytics platform of de-identified, real-world multimodal data. Through Tempus + Working Groups, we foster an ecosystem of thought leadership aimed at high-impact evidence generation to advance the frontiers of cancer care.
In this role, you will drive a continuous cycle of research strategy, evidence generation, adoption, and education. You will serve as the face of the Tempus + program, cultivating deep relationships with participating institutions, guiding clinical investigations, and scaling research output. Success in this role requires seamless partnership with specialized internal teams across Tempus to transform massive amounts of data into powerful research tools.
Key Responsibilities:

• Serve as the primary medical point of contact for Tempus + institutions, cultivating deep relationships with leading academic and community physicians.

• Foster a culture of research collaboration via collaborative working groups.

• Travel up to 20% to provide hands-on, on-site support, training, and relationship management at Tempus + institutions.

• Support researchers through the entire lifecycle:

• Hypothesis Generation: Help external investigators hone hypotheses and build formal research proposals.

• Data Exploration: Provide scientific and technical support to explore the Tempus + Data Library via the Lens platform.

• Publication Strategy: Collaborate on disclosure, presentation, and publication strategies for high-impact scientific journals.

• Shape clinical investigation strategies to ensure all research is scientifically sound, clinically valuable, and aligned with the latest oncology standards.

• Provide medical expertise and clinical context to internal data scientists, informaticians, and business development managers during external communications and customer interactions.

• Engage Tempus + sites with Lens utilization, molecular tumor boards, data integration, and clinical trial portfolios (including TIME, Studies, and Clinical Development).

• Deliver polished, clinically oriented presentations to medical audiences.

Qualifications:

• MD/DO or MD/DO/PhD with a strong background and clinical expertise in oncology or a closely related field.

• Experience directing multi-site observational projects, clinical registries, and precision medicine initiatives.

• Deep familiarity with medical informatics, advanced clinical data modeling, biomarker evaluation, genomic testing, and utilizing real-world data to solve complex oncologic questions.

• Innovative thinker who can build strong partnerships with key medium- to large-sized cancer hospital networks

• Ability to translate complex molecular and technical data into clear, actionable clinical insights.

• Experience with sales, sales strategy and marketing for commercial life science initiatives is preferred

title: Senior Business Developer - National Security

description:
Company Overview

The clients are a two-agent real estate team built around direct lead generation rather than relying on a brokerage's referral pipeline. Client 1 works primarily as a buyer's agent with a large personal sphere of influence, while Client 2 focuses on the listing side and maintains his own book of clients in Follow Up Boss. The team invests directly in leads - including tax record data, expired and withdrawn listings, for-sale-by-owner leads, and open house leads - so they can keep more of what they earn on each deal instead of splitting it with a brokerage.

Role Overview

Client 1 is running lead generation and client-facing transactions largely on his own and doesn't have the bandwidth to consistently work the volume of leads coming in. This role is an Inside Sales Agent (ISA) whose sole purpose is the investment side of the business: working through roughly 840-850 existing leads sitting dormant in the team's CRM, following up on batch-purchased leads (expired, withdrawn, FSBO) and open house leads, and keeping people warm until they're ready to meet.

The ISA will also spend time in Client 2's Follow Up Boss account, which holds a number of warm leads that go untouched while he's out on showings and listing appointments. Success in this role means booking qualified appointments - in person or by phone - where Client 1 or Client 2 can take over the conversation.

Key Responsibilities

• Make outbound calls to existing and newly purchased leads (old database leads, expired/withdrawn listings, FSBO leads, and open house leads) to re-engage and qualify them.

• Follow up consistently with leads over time to keep them warm until they're ready to transact.

• Gather buyer criteria on qualifying calls - target areas, price range, home style, bed/bath count, must-have amenities (e.g., proximity to a train station), and timeline.

• Book appointments or phone consultations for Client 1 (and occasionally Client 2) with qualified leads, and confirm they show up.

• Work leads inside the team's CRMs (HighLevel and Follow Up Boss) - logging call outcomes and moving leads through the pipeline.

• Spend part of the time managing and following up on warm leads already sitting in Client 2's Follow Up Boss account.

• Aim for a high volume of outbound activity - target is roughly 125-150+ calls per shift, working toward ~900 calls per week.

Skills & Tools

• Minimum 3-4 years of experience specifically in real estate cold calling / ISA work - general call center, pharmaceutical, or other consumer sales experience does not meet this requirement.

• Comfortable working in CRMs such as HighLevel and Follow Up Boss (training available, but prior CRM fluency is a plus).

• Strong phone presence - confident, personable, and persistent without being pushy.

• Well organized and consistent with follow-up; able to manage a high volume of leads without letting any go cold.

• Able to gather and accurately record buyer criteria and lead details.

• Reliable, self-directed, and comfortable working independently once given a lead list.

The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.”  learn more about working at Coinbase .

Data Science is an integral component of Coinbase’s product and decision making process: we work in partnership with Product, Engineering and Design to influence the roadmap and better understand our users. With a deep expertise in experimentation, analytics and advanced modeling, we produce insights which directly move the company’s bottom line.

As a Data Scientist in the consumer org, you'll apply these skills to improve the customer experience across Coinbase's consumer products-spot and advanced trading, yield, Coinbase One (CB1), international expansion, and new launches (including prediction markets and equities trading). You'll define and instrument key metrics, build measurement and causal frameworks, and translate insights into product strategy and shipped improvements.

What you'll be doing:

• Conduct analysis and deep dives on ambiguous problems for our business. Your work will result in insights and recommendations that guide the team’s decision making.

• Act as owner for a broad scope of data and metrics, from core logging to presentation of data visualizations. 

• Guide code reviews, provide SQL and Python expertise, and create well-maintained ETL jobs. 

• Maintain a high bar for statistical rigor on your team. Ensure that we’re conducting experimentation and causal analyses that build confidence with your stakeholders.

What we look for in you:

• A BA/BS in a quantitative field (ex Math, Stats, Physics, or Computer Science) with ≥5+ years of relevant experience or a PhD in a quantitative field with with ≥3+ years of relevant experience

• Demonstrated experience in driving impactful data science projects that tackle ambiguous problem spaces. 

• Ability to influence external stakeholders by synthesizing data learnings into compelling stories.

• Practical expertise in applying complex modeling frameworks to practical business problems. 

• Professional experience using SQL and Python.

• Experience working with digital products in an iterative development cycle.

• Demonstration of our core cultural values: clear communication, positive energy, continuous learning, and efficient execution.

• Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human-in-the-loop practices to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality.

title: Cellular Network Performance Analyst

Delart is home to a team of world-class engineers and project leaders dedicated to developing the next generation of advanced networking technologies, consumer devices, and innovative technology solutions. Trusted by some of the world’s leading technology companies, we deliver highly scalable, mission-critical solutions that power both consumer and business applications globally. Join our team as a network analytics specialist focused on enhancing end-to-end cellular network performance and improving application-layer Quality of Experience (QoE). You will design and implement advanced analytics solutions to extract actionable insights from massive volumes of network data, driving the evolution of mobile network services.

• Collaborate with network engineers and operators to optimize application-layer QoE based on analytical findings.

• Design and implement scalable data processing pipelines for processing large-scale network datasets.

• Advanced proficiency in Python, R, and SQL for data analytics and solution development.

• Demonstrated experience analyzing end-to-end cellular network data to generate actionable insights.

• Proven track record collaborating with network operators for data collection and analysis.

• Ability to architect and implement large-scale analytics solutions for network data processing.

• Familiarity with application-layer QoE optimization techniques and advanced performance analysis.

• Expertise with modern data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) and cloud-based analytics solutions (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).

description: About Genesis AI Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world. About the Role A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem. We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out. The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't. Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

Role Overview

Role:

We are looking for a Senior Staff Quantum Scientist to join our Science team at IonQ. In this role, you will take a leading role in our research efforts, driving experimental efforts and the architecture of our future generation quantum systems.

We are pioneering advancements in quantum computing by utilising trapped ion technology and our proprietary laser-free quantum control methods. Our research and development efforts build on our fully integrated quantum processors that can be fabricated within standard silicon foundries. This unique approach allows us to leverage the highest-performing qubit technology while ensuring scalability and manufacturability using existing semiconductor fabrication technology.

We approach quantum computing with a focus on minimising errors, striving to achieve ultra-low gate errors at scale. Our immediate objective is to develop functional quantum computers within the NISQ regime, aiming to construct fault-tolerant machines that require minimal QEC overhead. Our recent breakthroughs include achieving 99.97% fidelity in two-qubit gates and 99.9992% fidelity in single-qubit operations without error correction, setting new industry standards for performance.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior Staff Quantum Scientist you will be at the forefront of our research and development, taking a leading role within our experimental science team. You will be responsible for driving innovation in coherent control, calibration, and benchmarking at scale, with a particular focus on enabling ultra-low error rates and system reliability across larger trapped-ion devices.

You will work hands-on with our current hardware, with work spanning design, debugging, and executing experiments, developing novel control schemes, and pushing the boundaries of system performance.

Beyond hands-on experiments, you will help shape technical direction, mentor junior scientists, and ensure our work translates into scalable, fault-tolerant systems.

Key responsibilities include:

• Lead the prototyping and characterisation of advanced coherent control schemes for trapped-ion qubits using laser and microwave fields.

• Drive system-level benchmarking and optimisation, ensuring near-term devices achieve world-leading performance and stability.

• Validate and integrate new trap technologies (e.g. on-chip electronics or photonics) to support scaling towards error-corrected architectures.

• Guide junior scientists in experimental design, analysis, and presentation of results.

• Represent IonQ at conferences and external collaborations.

description:

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Space Imaging team is seeking a Systems Engineer to join our team. The Imaging Space team is responsible for system architecture definition, trade analyses, and modeling/validating system performance for spaceborne EO/IR systems.

In this role, you will be responsible for defining active EO/IR system architectures. You will perform radiometric performance modeling as well as laboratory, ground, and flight testing. To predict real-world performance, you will also model atmospheric and environmental effects for land, sea, and air targets. You will leverage your analyses to inform system-level architectural trades. As needed, you will also lead small teams of engineers from concept ideation through system definition and development.

You should have a track record of successfully working on fast-paced, highly technical, interdisciplinary teams. Proficiency in analytical toolchains or languages (e.g., MATLAB, Python) is required. Experience with industry standard EO/IR modeling software packages (e.g. MODTRAN, SPIRITS, AFSIM) is a plus. Prior experience working with space sensors and systems is highly desirable.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Define system architectures via detailed trade studies and analyses.

• Adapt or derive physics-based models of sensor system performance and derive requirements based on those models.

• Take ownership over the development of prototype sensor systems in a lab environment.

• Support both laboratory-based and field-based experiments and demonstrations.

• Engage technically with the hardware, software, and mission teams to define, integrate, and deliver high performance systems to our customers.

• Validate models against laboratory and real-world data.

• Coordinate and communicate with both external & internal stakeholders with varying degrees of technical background.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Model development and validation in one or more domains relevant to remote sensing

• Ability to decompose complex systems into functional parts, with clearly defined interfaces and requirements for each.

• Experience in system design and development from initial concept through test and delivery to customer.

• Strong laboratory skills (rapid prototyping, design of experiments) and familiarity with opto-electrical test and measurement equipment.

• Willingness to travel to test sites, as needed.

• Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Knowledge of current and next-generation advanced sensing systems and platforms

• Active and passive sensing domain experience (e.g., LiDAR, EO/IR, Radar)

• Experience with laser systems, including opto-mechanical scanning and beam steering techniques.

• Knowledge of electro-mechanical control systems, including their performance requirements and verification methodologies.

• Experience with LiDAR/Radar signal processing techniques, and knowledge of their implementation on real-time embedded platforms (FPGA, MCU, etc.).

• Experience with signature and/or scenario modeling/software packages (MODTRAN, SPIRITS, AFSIM).

• Space domain experience (architecting sensors for operation in space environments)

title: Speech Therapist
description:
Join Hire Hangar and work with fast-growing global companies while building a long-term career.

Location: Lawrenceville/Loganville/Hoschton/Peachtree Corners, GA

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $90,000-$120,000/year

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a compassionate and skilled Pediatric Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) to join our team. In this role, you will evaluate and treat children with a wide range of speech, language, and feeding/swallowing needs, working closely with families to guide them in understanding their child's areas of need and strengths. A central part of this position is helping families support their child's intervention and carryover of skills at home, at school, and in the community, ensuring progress made in session translates into everyday life.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conduct comprehensive speech, language, articulation, fluency, voice, and feeding/swallowing evaluations for pediatric clients

• Develop individualized treatment plans with measurable goals based on assessment findings and each child's developmental level

• Provide direct, evidence-based therapy for a caseload of pediatric clients with diverse communication and feeding disorders

• Guide families in understanding their child's areas of need and strengths, translating clinical findings into clear, actionable information

• Partner with parents and caregivers to support carryover of skills and strategies at home, at school, and in the community

• Coordinate and communicate with teachers, pediatricians, occupational and physical therapists, and other providers involved in the child's care

• Maintain accurate, timely clinical documentation, including evaluation reports, SOAP notes, progress notes, and insurance-required paperwork

• Track client progress toward goals on an ongoing basis and adjust treatment plans as needed

• Participate in team meetings, case conferences, and school-based meetings (e.g., IEP/IFSP) as needed

• Educate parents and caregivers on home exercise programs, strategies, and tools to reinforce therapy outside of sessions

• Stay current with best practices, research, and continuing education in pediatric speech-language pathology

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master's degree in Speech-Language Pathology from a program accredited by the Council on Academic Accreditation (CAA)

• Active Georgia state license in Speech-Language Pathology (or eligibility to obtain), and ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP)

• Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience working with pediatric clients across a range of speech, language, and feeding/swallowing disorders

• Strong understanding of child development and evidence-based assessment and treatment approaches for pediatric communication and feeding disorders

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to build rapport with children and explain clinical concepts clearly and empathetically to parents and caregivers

• Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams and to coordinate treatment carryover across home, school, and community settings

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience supervising Clinical Fellows (CFs) or graduate student clinicians

• Specialized training or certification (e.g., PROMPT, feeding and swallowing certifications, AAC)

• Bilingual or multilingual skills

• Prior experience in a private practice or pediatric outpatient setting

TOOLS & TECHNOLOGY

• Electronic health record / practice management systems (e.g., SimplePractice, TherapyNotes, WebPT, or similar)

• Standardized assessment tools (e.g., CELF, PLS-5, GFTA, or comparable pediatric speech/language batteries)

• Teletherapy platforms for virtual sessions, where applicable

• Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) devices and apps

• Microsoft Office / Google Workspace for documentation, scheduling, and reporting

title: Remote Clinical Validation Reviewer (RN)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary Provides support for inpatient and outpatient clinical claim review activities. Verifies that coded diagnoses, procedures, revenue codes, and corresponding reimbursement methodologies accurately reflect the member's documented clinical condition, services rendered, and billed charges. Assesses medical records for clinical accuracy, acuity alignment, and documentation integrity. Identifies inconsistencies that impact reimbursement such as unsupported diagnoses, incorrect procedure coding, or inaccurate revenue code assignment and determines whether billed services meet coding and billing guidelines, payer policy, and regulatory requirements. Contributes to overarching strategy to provide quality and cost-effective member care.
Essential Job Duties

• Reviews inpatient and/or outpatient claims to ensure diagnoses, procedures, revenue codes, itemized charges, and Diagnostic Related Groups (DRG) assignments accurately reflect the documented clinical condition and services provided.
• Integrates ICD‑10 coding principles, DRG methodologies, revenue code logic, and evidence‑based clinical guidelines when reviewing claims for accuracy, appropriateness, and alignment with documentation.
• Performs DRG validation reviews by verifying principal and secondary diagnoses, complications/comorbidities, procedure coding, severity level, and correct grouping logic.
• Conducts itemized bill reviews to confirm that charges are supported by clinical documentation, compliant with billing standards, and appropriate for the level of care delivered; identifies unsupported, inaccurate, or inappropriate coding or billing elements such as unsubstantiated diagnoses, incorrect procedures, or incorrect revenue code usage.
• Develops clear, evidence‑based written rationales supporting diagnosis, procedure, revenue code, or DRG recommendations and determinations.
• Substantiates all review outcomes using clinical indicators, documentation, coding guidelines, payer policy, and regulatory requirements.
• Performs review work independently, applying sound clinical judgment and specialized expertise to evaluate complex claim scenarios.
• Applies applicable federal/state regulations, official coding guidelines, payer policies, and Molina payment integrity standards during all reviews.
• Ensures compliance with DRG and itemized bill review criteria, clinical validation rules, and reimbursement methodologies.
• Collaborates with coding, payment integrity analytics, SIU, and physician advisors to clarify complex clinical documentation, coding discrepancies, or reimbursement determinations.
• Provides subject matter expertise on DRG validation, revenue code accuracy, itemized bill review, and documentation integrity to internal partners as needed.
• Meets or exceeds established productivity goals set by payment integrity leadership for clinical validation and claim review activities.
• Achieves the required accuracy and quality standards for review, diagnosis/procedure validation, and/or itemized bill reviews.
• Participates in quality checks, calibration sessions, and ongoing training to maintain consistency and strengthen review competency.
• Completes special projects and additional review assignments as delegated by leadership. Identifies patterns and trends in documentation, coding, or billing that may require internal escalation, provider education, or process improvement.
• Supports continuous improvement efforts by contributing insights that enhance review processes, criteria application, and workflow efficiency.

Required Qualifications

• At least 2 years of experience in inpatient payment integrity medical claim review including DRG validation or itemized bill review, and experience working with ICD-10, MS-DRG, AP-DRG and APR-DRG, CPT, HCPCS, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
• Registered Nurse (RN). License must be active and unrestricted in state of practice.

• Advanced in DRG methodologies.

title: Manager, Talent Account Management
description:
Overview
Together, We Enhance Innovation and Growth
The Manager, Talent Account Management leads the team of Talent Account Managers (TAMs) who run i2G's hiring process from intake to close. The TAMs own the hiring manager relationship and the candidate experience once a candidate enters an active process. This Manager makes sure that work is focused on the right roles, delivered to a consistent standard, and measured in a way the business can trust.
The role is accountable for delivery outcomes, reporting, customer satisfaction and escalations. It works from the priority order set jointly with the Capacity Planning Manager, so that TAM time goes to the roles that matter most to i2G's contracts and markets. It operates on Kastle Systems' talent platforms (iCIMS, LinkedIn and Indeed) and draws its candidate supply from Kastle's Sourcing team.
This is a leadership and delivery role, not a sourcing role and not a demand-planning role. It does not own the demand forecast, which sits with the Capacity Planning Manager. It does not own top-of-funnel sourcing, which sits with Kastle's Sourcing team. It owns what happens between those two: turning qualified leads into hires, and doing it well.
Reporting and working relationships

•
Chief Operating Officer, i2G (direct). Sets business priorities for the team, evaluates performance and is the escalation point for delivery and resourcing issues.

•
Senior Director, Talent Acquisition, Kastle Systems (indirect). Sets recruiting process standards, platform usage and compliance expectations, and partners on team practices and reporting.

•
Capacity Planning Manager, i2G (peer). Owns the labor demand forecast and the rolling requisition priority order. The two roles agree together where TAM effort goes each month.

•
Kastle Sourcing team (upstream partner). Supplies sourced and inbound candidates to the TAMs. This Manager owns the quality feedback loop back to Sourcing.

•
i2G hiring managers and branch leadership (customers). The people the TAMs serve. This Manager is the senior point of contact for their satisfaction and their escalations.

Responsibilities
Key responsibilities
1. Team leadership and coaching

• Lead, coach and develop three Talent Account Managers. Set clear expectations, run regular one-to-ones and case reviews, and give direct performance feedback.

• Assign requisition portfolios to TAMs based on priority, complexity, market and workload, and rebalance as demand shifts.

• Set and audit the standard for the TAM role: intake quality, screening rigor, submittal quality, interview coordination, feedback turnaround, offer preparation and close.

• Coach TAMs on running difficult conversations with hiring managers, including pushing back on unrealistic requirements or slow decisions.

• Hire, onboard and backfill TAMs as needed, and maintain a development path for the team.

2. Prioritization and alignment with capacity planning

• Work with the Capacity Planning Manager as the single point of alignment between operations demand and TAM delivery.

• Run the team from the rolling 90-day requisition forecast and its agreed priority order. Confirm each month which roles get TAM focus first.

• Make sure TAM effort follows priority, not volume of requests or the loudest hiring manager. Flag when priorities conflict or when demand exceeds what the team can deliver.

• Take part in the monthly talent acquisition and operations review with data, recommendations and follow-through on decisions.

• Raise early warning when a priority role is at risk, including the revenue or delivery consequence, so trade-offs are made with full information.

3. Hiring manager partnership and customer satisfaction

• Own the operating relationship with i2G hiring managers and branch leadership at the leadership level, and hold the TAMs to a consistent service standard.

• Set and enforce an intake standard so every requisition has a clear profile, priority, compensation range and interview plan befo

title: Refrigeration Technician
description:
Job Description:  As a Refrigeration Technician, you will work with the maintenance team to maintain, troubleshoot, and repair HVAC, refrigeration and facilities equipment to maintain critical temperatures and improve reliability of our systems. This role is the resident expert in refrigeration systems. 

Shift: Monday to Friday - 3:00pm to 11:30pm or 4:00pm to 12:30am

You will...

• Maintain and operate industrial refrigeration systems including large rack systems, split systems, blast chillers, cooling towers and ancillary equipment.

• Lead and educate compliance with all safety, food safety, and security standards. 

• Perform preventive maintenance and routine inspections on assigned refrigeration and HVAC systems and ancillary equipment as needed. 

• Perform troubleshooting of assigned out of service equipment and correct issues, act as an escalation point for lower-level technicians, and escalate to leadership and/or vendors as needed for additional troubleshooting.

• Document all work in the computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) and ticketing systems as appropriate.

• Mentor all maintenance personnel in developing appropriate skill sets and knowledge of equipment specializing in refrigeration.

• Lead root cause analysis of major downtime events.

• Act as a network resource for technical issues and lead network-wide root cause analysis.

• Develop maintenance personnel knowledge on intermediate to advanced refrigeration processes, tools and techniques.

• Audit maintenance personnel work and provide feedback to improve performance and quality.

• Audit vendor work to provide feedback to leadership on quality of work and SLA performance.

• Write and/or modify PMs to standardize across the network and increase effectiveness.

• Repair and perform predictive and preventative maintenance procedures on CO2 and Freon refrigeration systems including, but not limited to compressors, pumps, fans, heat exchangers, glycol systems, various industrial utility systems, motors, and power distribution systems.

• Give direction and/or training to entry level refrigeration technicians including, but not limited to day-to-day operations, inspections and inspection techniques, basic repairs and repair techniques, and conformance to all state, local, and HelloFresh regulations and policies.

• Perform building project work as assigned.

You have...

• 4-6 years of experience with refrigeration repair and maintenance in an industrial setting, 

• Advanced understanding of rack system refrigeration and associated equipment.

• Experience with repair and maintenance of glycol systems, heat exchangers, HVAC, and water chiller systems.

• Experience with electrical systems including single and three phase motor systems, power distribution, and low voltage controls with the ability to troubleshoot to the component level.

• Current Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Section 608 certification.

• All necessary regulatory licenses required by local municipalities to work in the field of industrial refrigeration.

• Ability to demonstrate excellent work habits in line with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP’s).

• Ability to conform to all OSHA, PSM, HAZMAT, and HelloFresh safety programs and regulations.

• Ability to demonstrate understanding of proper handling and recycling procedures for chlorofluorocarbon (CFC), hydrochlorofluorocarbon (HCFC), Hydrofluro-Olefins (HFO), CO2, and other industry standard refrigerant types.

• Ability to safely replace mechanical and electrical components including motors, motor starters, switches, solenoids, pumps, refrigeration valves, compressors, and auxiliary refrigeration equipment.

• Experience working with a wide range of networked refrigeration controls platforms.

• Ability to withstand walking, lifting, bending, stooping, climbing ladders, walking on roofs, and working in confined spaces.

• Basic computer skills.

• Ability to read and understand drawings,

Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

WHY THIS ROLE

Every one of Multiverse's 800+ employees needs data to do their job well, and in the AI era - our ability to leverage data is more important than ever!

As Director of Data Products, you will own the platform, the products, the tools, the processes and the self-serve layer, so that the answer arrives before the request does.

You will be a force-multiplier for the quality, velocity and impact of Multiverse's decision making, and a driving force behind how data and AI are leveraged across the entire business. You will ensure that how we interact with data and deliver data products fully realises the potential of AI.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

DATA LEVERAGE ACROSS MULTIVERSE

- Real adoption, through documentation, training and support that reaches every relevant domain. Optimising the user experience alongside secure controls and seamless interconnectivity (APIs, MCPs).

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ROADMAP DELIVERY

- D&I's operational planning process: around 50 quarterly projects properly scoped, clearly defined and appropriately resourced, with capacity reallocated as priorities move.

- Representation of D&I in company-wide planning and governance forums, bringing a data lens to decisions being made elsewhere in the business.

- A roadmap that reflects genuine business priority rather than the loudest request, with data needs surfaced early.

- Progress against milestones - risks identified ahead of time, blockers raised, solutions coordinated.

OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE

- Driving the team's cycle planning, standups and retrospectives, run so they are genuinely useful and action-oriented.

- Standards, playbooks and best practice for how work is scoped, how handoffs happen and how outputs are documented - with AI embedded where it creates real leverage.

- Fair triage of inbound support and feature requests, and an escalation route for issues that cross domain boundaries.

• Provision and manage integration infrastructure using infrastructure as code (Bicep, ARM, or Terraform).

• Develop reusable integration templates, patterns, and shared components.

• Develop automated unit, integration, and regression tests for integration workflows.

• Develop and maintain integration documentation, interface specifications, and an integration catalog.

• Conduct code reviews, performance tuning, and security reviews of integration workloads.

• Work with cross-functional teams, application owners, vendors, and stakeholders to gather, define, and refine integration requirements.

- Build interactive prototypes to explore product behavior, communicate ideas, and test assumptions before development

- Use research, usability testing, product data, and feedback to inform decisions and improve experiences

- Have a strong command of typography, composition, color, layout, and visual hierarchy

- Think beyond individual screens to consider complete journeys, interaction patterns, accessibility, and edge cases

- Are proficient in Figma and comfortable working with tokens, components, design systems

- Have strong instincts but welcome feedback, evidence, and better ideas

- Are autonomous and comfortable making progress when the path is not fully defined

description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

TURNING PUBLISHER DATA INTO PROACTIVE BUSINESS DECISIONS

This Data Analyst role sits within our Rewarded Analytics team, focusing on enterprise publisher analytics.

When working with large enterprise publishers, performance monitoring goes beyond tracking numbers. Contractual commitments, business KPIs, and publisher-specific requirements need to be monitored continuously to identify potential risks before they become critical issues.

Working closely with our Growth Managers and Partner Operations you will provide the insights and analytical solutions that help our largest publishers grow. You'll investigate large datasets, build automated reports, monitoring dashboards, and alerts that highlight performance trends and flag when a publisher may be at risk of missing its targets.

From forecasting KPI performance to preparing dashboards for Quarterly Business Reviews, your work will enable our business teams to make informed decisions, take action earlier, and provide better support to our enterprise publishers.

YOUR MISSION & WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

- Technically skilled Data Analyst : You have 3+ years of experience in data analytics and are confident using SQL and Python, R, or another programming language to analyse data, investigate issues, and identify trends.

- Business-minded. You understand business KPIs and can turn data into clear insights that help teams make better decisions.

- Proactive problem-solver. You identify potential risks and opportunities before they become problems, rather than waiting for requests.

- Automation-oriented. You enjoy building automated reports, dashboards, and alerts that reduce manual work and make insights readily available.

- A confident stakeholder partner. You communicate clearly, build strong relationships with different teams, and feel comfortable challenging assumptions and pushing back when needed.

- Curious and collaborative. You take ownership, bring a positive attitude, and enjoy improving how things work.

🌎 WE WELCOME APPLICATIONS FROM TALENT WORLDWIDE AND PROVIDE RELOCATION SUPPORT TO HAMBURG, GERMANY FOR THOSE READY TO JOIN OUR TEAM.

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

- Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

- Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

- Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

- Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

- Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

title: Flight Operations Lead Captain
description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service - spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack - from the lab to the field - we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Air Mobility Group (AIRMOB)  is responsible for developing and delivering Metrea’s aerial refueling (AAR) capabilities, ensuring the readiness and operational effectiveness of the tanker fleet. AIRMOB oversees fleet management, maintenance, and airworthiness, working to sustain and enhance refueling operations. It manages the integration of new processes and technologies, ensuring that tanker aircraft remain mission-ready through effective logistics, maintenance oversight, and regulatory compliance. By coordinating across various teams, AIRMOB ensures the fleet meets both current and future operational needs, supporting a range of specialized air mobility missions.

Position Summary

The Flight Operations Pilot Liaison is a pivotal role responsible for ensuring operational excellence, safety, and regulatory compliance of our flight operations. This position requires an individual with exceptional leadership skills and in-depth knowledge of FAA regulations who will uphold the standards of Metrea's flight operations and safety procedures.  This role oversees and vectors pilots to maintain the highest standards of safety and proficiency and assists the Head of Flight Operations on administrative and operational tasks.

In addition to these leadership responsibilities, the position also serves as a Pilot-in-Command (PIC) of Metrea Strategic Mobility’s KC-135 tanker aircraft. In this capacity, the individual exercises final authority for the safe and compliant operation of assigned missions, leads flight crews through all phases of flight, and ensures strict adherence to FAA regulations, company policies, operational specifications, and contractual requirements. PIC responsibilities include mission planning and execution, sound aeronautical decision-making consistent with the SMS, and the completion of post-flight duties. The role requires maintaining all required qualifications, training, certifications, and currency, and performing additional flight-related duties as assigned.

What You'll Do

• Responsible for the Pilot Records Database (PRD) process, in determining hiring eligibility for crew members

• Acts as a liaison between crew members and other managers

• May plan and modify routes for company aircraft in operations

• Maintain an adequate roster of properly qualified

This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

This role owns email and lifecycle marketing across three properties: Shadow, Darkroom, and our CEO's personal newsletter. Our marketing team publishes a high volume of content across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, YouTube, a podcast, and a creator program, and very little of it has an email path behind it. You build that path and then run it.

Shadow is the priority. It needs a direct funnel that takes someone from a creator post or a LinkedIn post into an email sequence and through to a signup, and that funnel does not exist today. This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone, and we are hiring for it in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.
